method: Genuine founder Chrome session; same-origin authenticated GET with Vercel deployment pin, candidate identity checked before and after
receiptScope: Every returned OPENED receipt with cards; each receipt checked for unique card IDs. Existing NFL, AFL and NRL receipts were recovered; historical basketball audit records were preserved.
routingNote: Top-level navigation ignored the dpl pin; this was rejected as candidate evidence. Same-origin fetch returned the exact candidate. The first CDP command exceeded the tool's 3-second response limit; the complete read-only result was collected with the documented longer command timeout. No application changes or security bypass were used.
